Nathan Brooks  
Email: nathan.brooks@email.com | Phone: +91 9876543210 | Location: Bangalore, India  

Professional Experience  
At Ludum Dynamics, I oversee QA operations for a team of 30 engineers, ensuring cross-platform game stability across 12 titles. My focus on automated regression suites reduced manual testing hours by 40% in the last fiscal year. I led the integration of CI/CD pipelines into the development workflow, aligning testing phases with sprint cycles to cut release bottlenecks by 25%. At PixelForge, I designed performance testing frameworks using JMeter and k6 to simulate 50,000 concurrent players, identifying latency issues in multiplayer mechanics. Prior roles included scaling test automation with Selenium and Playwright across 15+ game modules, while mentoring QA leads to refine test strategy design for AAA titles.  

Education  
Master’s in Software Engineering, University of California, Berkeley (2018). Thesis: "Optimizing Test Coverage in Distributed Game Systems."  

Technical Skills  
- CI/CD pipelines: Implemented Jenkins-based workflows to automate test deployment for 8 game titles, reducing integration delays by 30%.  
- Performance testing (JMeter/k6): Instrumented stress tests for a 30-player co-op game, resolving server-side synchronization bugs.  
- Python: Developed custom scripts to parse test logs and generate defect prioritization matrices for 10+ titles.  
- Selenium/Playwright: Built cross-browser compatibility frameworks for 12 game features, ensuring 98% pass rates in pre-release testing.  
- Test automation: Spearheaded the transition from manual to automated testing for 60% of the QA workload at PixelForge.  
- Test strategy design: Coordinated with developers to align test cases with game architecture, improving defect detection rates by 20%.  
- Java: Utilized for backend integration testing in 3 titles, ensuring API consistency across platforms.  

Projects  
- **Game Engine Test Framework**: Developed a Python-based framework using Selenium and Playwright to automate UI testing for a AAA game engine, reducing regression cycle time by 35%.  
- **Multiplayer Latency Optimization**: Led performance testing with JMeter to identify and resolve network latency issues in a 50-player battle royale game, improving average ping by 18%.
